units.source_text: “可是……恕我直言，《卟—弗日报》难道不是支持工人的报纸吗？

en.t: But... if I may speak frankly, isn't the Boo-Foo Daily supposed to be a newspaper that supports the workers?

units.source_text: 你说这家报纸的社长哙哙也受你操纵，那不就是说……”

en.t: You say that Kuaikuai, the president of this newspaper, is also under your control, which means...
